name: veterinary_clinic_system_005_vaccine_lot_recall_trace
instruction: The manufacturer recalled one vaccine lot: the lot_number that appears most frequently across all vaccination records is suspect (break a tie by choosing the alphabetically smallest lot_number). Find every patient who received that lot, and for each affected patient's owner push one communications row with channel='phone', direction='outbound', subject='Vaccine lot recall — <lot_number>', body='Recall callback scheduled for <PatientName> (lot <lot_number>).', logged_by='Dr. Alvarez', and occurred_at on the episode date. One row per affected patient (not per vaccination). Do not touch any seeded communications.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute modal lot from snapshot vaccinations (count per lot_number, tie -> alphabetical min). Affected = distinct patient_ids having that lot. Assert exactly one new communications row per affected patient with all fields exact; assert seeded 16 rows unchanged; total == 16 + len(affected); no extras.

checks.expect: Recompute modal lot from snapshot vaccinations (count per lot_number, tie -> alphabetical min). Affected = distinct patient_ids having that lot. Assert exactly one new communications row per affected
